items.title: Schema-valid output for every public CLI command
items.guarantee: Every public CLI command emits a schema-valid ToolResult.
items.enforcement: The CLI validates every handler result before canonical serialization and replaces invalid envelopes with an explicit internal-error result.
items.owner_action: Keep the command matrix synchronized with every public CLI addition.

items.title: No silent log-line loss
items.guarantee: log parse accounts for every input line; unmatched lines become unknown_event and never disappear.
items.enforcement: The parser emits one event inside the loop over each input line and reports totals for every parse state.
items.owner_action: Repair the parser or narrow the public guarantee if line accounting fails.

items.title: No false passed test claims
items.guarantee: test parse maps killed or incomplete runs to non-passed states and never claims passed without observed completed evidence.
items.enforcement: Interrupted-run checks precede pass classification; pass requires an observed command, exit code zero, and observed passing test records.
items.owner_action: Repair test-state precedence before accepting any passing claim.

items.title: No report claims without evidence
items.guarantee: report summarize makes no test claim when observed_test_results is absent.
items.enforcement: The summarizer derives tests_observed only from the evidence package and defaults to an empty list.
items.owner_action: Repair the facts-only mapping before publishing reports.

items.title: Sensitive content is not exposed
items.guarantee: .env and private-key content expose neither content nor hashes.
items.enforcement: Sensitive path matching prevents reads and content scanning blocks detected key material before hashes are emitted.
items.owner_action: Treat any exposure as a security defect and keep the item incomplete.

items.title: Symlink escapes are blocked
items.guarantee: Symlinks resolving outside the repository root are blocked and unreadable.
items.enforcement: Resolved-path containment is checked before stat or read operations.
items.owner_action: Repair containment enforcement before inventory can be trusted.

items.title: Deterministic CLI evidence output
items.guarantee: Identical CLI input produces byte-identical stdout and stderr.
items.enforcement: Stable hashes, deterministic run IDs, and canonical sorted JSON remove output variation.
items.owner_action: Remove output nondeterminism or document a narrower contract.

items.title: Timeout fallback is observable
items.guarantee: on_timeout fallback is separately reachable and observable.
items.enforcement: The CLI stops before dispatch on a non-positive timeout and emits the configured fallback.
items.owner_action: Repair timeout routing if fallback evidence is absent.

items.title: Invalid-schema fallback is observable
items.guarantee: on_invalid_schema fallback is separately reachable and observable.
items.enforcement: Post-dispatch schema validation replaces invalid handler output with the configured fallback.
items.owner_action: Repair the output boundary if invalid envelopes escape.

items.title: Policy fallback is observable
items.guarantee: on_policy_violation fallback is separately reachable and observable.
items.enforcement: Capability checks precede dispatch and emit policy_blocked with the configured fallback.
items.owner_action: Repair policy routing before enabling affected commands.

items.title: Internal-error fallback is observable
items.guarantee: on_internal_error fallback is separately reachable and observable.
items.enforcement: The CLI boundary catches unexpected handler exceptions and emits the configured fallback.
items.owner_action: Repair the boundary if unexpected exceptions escape.

items.title: Repository-root allowlist
items.guarantee: Repository roots outside allowed_repository_roots are denied.
items.enforcement: Root allowlist validation runs before Git or inventory dispatch.
items.owner_action: Repair root validation before repository reads are allowed.

items.title: Git facts are read-only
items.guarantee: git facts can invoke only its closed read-only Git command set.
items.enforcement: The collector has a fixed internal call sequence and exposes no caller-controlled Git arguments.
items.owner_action: Remove mutating commands before accepting the collector.

items.title: Default policy denies mutation and network authority
items.guarantee: denies network, edit, commit, merge, deploy by default; semantic authority is default-off but may be narrowly enabled for the gated bounded clustering task under [automatic].semantic_log_clustering, never for code_artifact
items.enforcement: The shipped policy denies network and mutation capabilities, keeps semantic clustering default-off, and requires both [semantic].enabled and [automatic].semantic_log_clustering before dispatch; code_artifact remains disabled.
items.owner_action: Keep the semantic exception limited to gated bounded clustering and never enable code_artifact.

items.title: Reports remain facts-only
items.guarantee: Reports do not diagnose root cause or choose architecture beyond observed evidence.
items.enforcement: The renderer has a closed facts-only mapping sourced from the evidence package.
items.owner_action: Remove unsupported inference before reports are accepted.

items.title: Test-parser invocation remains advisory
items.guarantee: The absence of technical enforcement requiring Codex to call ldw test parse is publicly disclosed.
items.enforcement: Prompt and operating agreement only; no hook, shell wrapper, or runner interception exists.
items.owner_action: User must choose an option in AI-02 before enforcement can change.

items.title: Personal telemetry on real sessions
items.owner_action: Run at least 10 real CLI calls and verify the privacy-safe summary.

items.title: Choose SA-16 enforcement posture
items.owner_action: Keep SA-16 advisory and verify that no wrapper or interception mechanism is installed.
